narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A square has only two lines of symmetry, because the two diagonals are the only fold lines.
<bookmark mark='fold'/>Fold the square up and down, and then sideways. The halves match both times.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The square has more fold lines than the two diagonals.

narration: <bookmark mark='fold'/>To check, fold each paper shape every way the halves match, and count the fold lines.
<bookmark mark='sides'/>Then count the sides. For a regular shape, the two counts must agree.
